directive_basis: R404 item 10: current maturity -> next experiment -> expected information gain -> evidence required -> commercial state after PASS -> commercial state after FAIL. The bridge between scientific truth and technology transfer.

chain.current_maturity: ENGINEERING_DEFINED + SYNTHETIC_LOOP_VERIFIED (the only non-NONE loop state — machinery only): CAD valid (0.18 mm gap re-verified), causal chain explicit, honest modeled comparison (ASD better at target-flow 3/4 postures), 0 ESTABLISHED advantages, 2 UNESTABLISHED differentiators, decisive experiment COSTED ($15K / 8 weeks, recorded)
chain.next_experiment: The recorded 3-arm bench protocol (R339, lifted into DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json): mock CSF loop, damper vs REAL ASD vs standard valve, 4 postural pressures (10/20/30/40 mmHg), 10 runs each, blinded — the two unestablished differentiators as primary endpoints
chain.expected_information_gain: The package's ONLY two claims (response speed, proportional modulation) get their first physical evidence, measured against the incumbent device on identical instrumentation — plus the modeled target-flow disadvantage (3/4 postures) gets its bench verdict; this is the complete resolution of the package's claim set in one protocol
chain.evidence_required: Response-time to postural step (damper vs ASD); proportional flow-modulation error (damper vs ASD); target-flow accuracy comparison; pre-registered clinically-material margins (owner-gated pre-registration)
chain.commercial_state_after_PASS: Both differentiators material + target-flow not materially worse -> first PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION; the package graduates from 'hypothesis about two unestablished differentiators' to 'measured advantage profile vs the incumbent' — SPONSORED_VALIDATION evidence gate satisfied on the technical axis
chain.commercial_state_after_FAIL: Neither differentiator material -> the R339-recorded rule: repair pipeline, then cemetery if repair fails; the lesson (proportional damping does not beat binary ASD for this application) is codified (Art. LI). MIXED outcomes recorded exactly so — no partial promotion
